title: Chinese New Year Self-Rescuing Guide
synopsis: The Spring Festival is often viewed as a time of joy, but most young people often return home with mixed emotions.

fullText.simplified:
春节自救指南

    最近，一首叫做《春节自救指南》的歌在网上流行。这是上海彩虹合唱团为春节回家的年轻人们唱的新歌，描述了春节时发生在长辈和年轻人之间的对话和问题。
    春节是一个团圆的节日，可是年轻人们回家后总是需要回答亲戚们的各种问题，比如说什么时候结婚，什么时候生孩子，买房子了没有，工资多少等等。亲戚们觉得问你问题是代表关心，这都是为了你好，年轻人们应该听老人的话；而年轻人们不想回答这些问题，认为这些都是他们的个人隐私，不需要别人告诉自己应该怎么做。
    现在越来越多的年轻人怕回家，就是因为不想面对亲戚们的“关心”。他们希望自己决定做什么工作，什么时候结婚，要不要生孩子，要不要买房子，而不是只听从长辈的意见。
    这首歌在提出这个问题的同时，也告诉人们，解决这个问题不仅靠智慧，也需要爱。老人们和年轻人们应该多沟通，互相理解。
fullText.traditional:
春節自救指南

    最近，一首叫做《春節自救指南》的歌在網上流行。這是上海彩虹合唱團為春節回家的年輕人們唱的新歌，描述了春節時發生在長輩和年輕人之間的對話和問題。
    春節是一個團圓的節日，可是年輕人們回家後總是需要回答親戚們的各種問題，比如說什麼時候結婚，什麼時候生孩子，買房子了沒有，工資多少等等。親戚們覺得問你問題是代表關心，這都是為了你好，年輕人們應該聽老人的話；而年輕人們不想回答這些問題，認為這些都是他們的個人隱私，不需要別人告訴自己應該怎麼做。
    現在越來越多的年輕人怕回家，就是因為不想面對親戚們的“關心”。他們希望自己決定做什麼工作，什麼時候結婚，要不要生孩子，要不要買房子，而不是只聽從長輩的意見。
    這首歌在提出這個問題的同時，也告訴人們，解決這個問題不僅靠智慧，也需要愛。老人們和年輕人們應該多溝通，互相理解。

raw.synopsis: The Spring Festival is often viewed as a time of joy, but most young people often return home with mixed emotions.
sentence_translations: Chinese New Year Self-Rescuing Guide
Recently, a song called “Chinese New Year Self-Rescuing Guide” became popular online.
This is a new song by the Shanghai Rainbow Chamber Singers, made for young people going home during Chinese New Year.
The song describes the conversations and problems which can take place between the older generation and young people.
Chinese New Year is a festival of reunion and happiness.
However, when young people go back home they always have to answer various questions from their relatives.
For example, when they are going to get married, when they are going to have kids, ..
.. if they have bought a apartment, how much their salary is, and so on.
Relatives think asking questions is equal to caring, and that it’s for your own good.
Young people are supposed to listen to the words of the older generation.
However, young people often don’t want to answer these sort of questions.
Thinking they are too personal and they don’t need others telling them what they should do.
Nowadays more and more young people are afraid of going back home, ..
.. since they don’t want to face this kind of “caring” from relatives.
Young people want to decide for themselves what to do for a living, ..
.. when to get married, to have kids or not, or buying an apartment or not.
They don’t want to just listen to the older generation’s opinions.
When the choir brought up this problem in their song, ..
.. they told people that not only wisdom but also love is needed in order to solve this problem.
Older people and young people need to communicate more in order to understand each other.
